acceptance: A red test runs ste-lint --changed from a linked worktree whose doc differs from the main checkout, with EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT set to the main checkout, and gets the worktree finding.
Outside a git tree EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT is still the root.
100% coverage on steLintRoot; guard bundle green.

consumed.resolution: landed in PR #1199 through the wave-144 boundary batch #1206 (merge fb1280de0)

fix: steLintRoot (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_docs.go) resolves --project-root, then EVOLVE_WORKTREE_ROOT, then the git top level of the current directory, and uses EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT only outside a git tree.
summary: In a build pane the root of `evolve docs ste-lint --changed` fell back to EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT (the main checkout), because the pane has no EVOLVE_WORKTREE_ROOT. The builder self-check linted the wrong tree and passed, and the floor then failed the build (cycles 2049, 2051).
title: evolve docs ste-lint resolves the root from the git worktree of the current directory before EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT
